title: Horizontal Single-Phase Gas Flowline
description: CFL-stable horizontal dry natural gas export flowline with single-section discretization, inlet mass source, and topside pressure boundary.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Model Title="Horizontal Single-Phase Gas Export Flowline" Author="FlowAssuranceTeam">
  <Integration StartTime="0" EndTime="1800" MinDt="0.005" MaxDt="0.5" />

  <Flowpath Name="GAS_EXPORT_LINE">
    <Pipe Label="TRUNK_SEG_1" Length="4000" Diameter="0.3048" Elevation="0" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Pipe Label="TRUNK_SEG_2" Length="4000" Diameter="0.3048" Elevation="0" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Source Name="GAS_WELLHEAD" Position="0" TotalMassRate="32.0" GasMassFraction="0.98" WaterCut="0.01" Temperature="62C" Pressure="115bar" />
    <HeatTransfer Type="AIR" AmbientTemperature="15C" AmbientHeatTransferCoeff="25">
      <Layer Material="CARBON_STEEL" Thickness="0.016" Conductivity="45.0" />
      <Layer Material="FBE_COATING" Thickness="0.004" Conductivity="0.30" />
    </HeatTransfer>
  </Flowpath>

  <Node Name="INLET_MANIFOLD" Type="TERMINAL" Flowpath="GAS_EXPORT_LINE" BoundaryPosition="0.0" MassRate="32.0" Temperature="62C" Pressure="115bar" />
  <Node Name="RECEIVING_STATION" Type="PRESSURE" Flowpath="GAS_EXPORT_LINE" BoundaryPosition="1.0" Pressure="68bar" Temperature="28C" />
</Model>

title: Inclined Gas-Condensate Tieback with Liquid Holdup
description: Undulating offshore gas-condensate pipeline with uphill and downhill terrain segments modeling condensate accumulation, pressure drop, and thermal heat loss.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Model Title="Inclined Gas-Condensate Tieback" Author="FlowAssuranceTeam">
  <Integration StartTime="0" EndTime="3600" MinDt="0.002" MaxDt="0.4" />

  <Flowpath Name="CONDENSATE_TIEBACK">
    <Pipe Label="WELLHEAD_DROP" Length="2500" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="-85" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Pipe Label="SEABED_VALLEY" Length="3200" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="-25" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Pipe Label="SHORE_APPROACH" Length="2800" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="115" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Valve Name="INLET_CHOKE" AbsolutePosition="8450" Diameter="0.18" Opening="0.80" Cd="0.84" />
    <Source Name="CONDENSATE_WELL" Position="0" TotalMassRate="48.5" GasMassFraction="0.62" WaterCut="0.06" Temperature="78C" Pressure="145bar" />
    <HeatTransfer Type="WATER" AmbientTemperature="6C" AmbientHeatTransferCoeff="180">
      <Layer Material="CARBON_STEEL" Thickness="0.019" Conductivity="45.0" />
      <Layer Material="POLYPROPYLENE" Thickness="0.040" Conductivity="0.22" />
    </HeatTransfer>
  </Flowpath>

  <Node Name="SUBSEA_TREE" Type="TERMINAL" Flowpath="CONDENSATE_TIEBACK" BoundaryPosition="0.0" MassRate="48.5" Temperature="78C" Pressure="145bar" />
  <Node Name="SLUG_CATCHER" Type="PRESSURE" Flowpath="CONDENSATE_TIEBACK" BoundaryPosition="1.0" Pressure="42bar" Temperature="24C" />
</Model>

title: Subsea S-Curve Riser Severe Slugging Analysis
description: Deepwater seabed tieback feeding a steep catenary riser equipped with a PID topside anti-slug choke controller to mitigate severe riser-base terrain slugging.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Model Title="Subsea S-Curve Riser Severe Slugging Analysis" Author="FlowAssuranceTeam">
  <Integration StartTime="0" EndTime="7200" MinDt="0.001" MaxDt="0.3" />

  <Flowpath Name="DEEPWATER_RISER_LOOP">
    <Pipe Label="SEABED_DECLINE" Length="3600" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="-420" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="12" />
    <Pipe Label="RISER_BASE_SAG" Length="1200" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="-40" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="8" />
    <Pipe Label="LAZY_WAVE_RISER" Length="1500" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="480" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Valve Name="ANTISLUG_CHOKE" AbsolutePosition="6250" Diameter="0.16" Opening="0.65" Cd="0.82" />
    <Controller Name="RISER_BASE_PID" Type="PID" SetPoint="62.0" Gain="0.85" Ti="45.0" Td="2.0" Transmitter="PT_RISER_BASE" ControlledValve="ANTISLUG_CHOKE" />
    <Source Name="MANIFOLD_SRC" Position="0" TotalMassRate="38.0" GasMassFraction="0.24" WaterCut="0.12" Temperature="72C" Pressure="165bar" />
    <HeatTransfer Type="WATER" AmbientTemperature="4C" AmbientHeatTransferCoeff="220">
      <Layer Material="CARBON_STEEL" Thickness="0.022" Conductivity="45.0" />
      <Layer Material="SYNTACTIC_FOAM" Thickness="0.055" Conductivity="0.14" />
    </HeatTransfer>
  </Flowpath>

  <Node Name="SUBSEA_MANIFOLD" Type="TERMINAL" Flowpath="DEEPWATER_RISER_LOOP" BoundaryPosition="0.0" MassRate="38.0" Temperature="72C" Pressure="165bar" />
  <Node Name="FPSO_SEPARATOR" Type="PRESSURE" Flowpath="DEEPWATER_RISER_LOOP" BoundaryPosition="1.0" Pressure="34bar" Temperature="25C" />
</Model>

title: Cold Shutdown & Hydrate Cooldown Thermal Profile
description: Insulated pipe-in-pipe subsea oil-gas tieback with multi-layer thermal coating, wax cloud-point monitoring, and controlled low-rate turndown to evaluate hydrate cooldown margin.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Model Title="Cold Shutdown and Hydrate Cooldown Thermal Profile" Author="FlowAssuranceTeam">
  <Integration StartTime="0" EndTime="28800" MinDt="0.005" MaxDt="0.5" />

  <Flowpath Name="INSULATED_PIP_TIEBACK">
    <Pipe Label="WELLHEAD_JUMPER" Length="1800" Diameter="0.2032" Elevation="-90" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="6" />
    <Pipe Label="MAIN_PIP_TRUNK" Length="6000" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="-40" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="15" />
    <Pipe Label="RISER_SPOOL" Length="1600" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="135" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="8" />
    <Valve Name="SHUTDOWN_CHOKE" AbsolutePosition="9350" Diameter="0.14" Opening="0.25" Cd="0.82" />
    <Source Name="SUBSEA_WELL_B" Position="0" TotalMassRate="26.0" GasMassFraction="0.18" WaterCut="0.15" Temperature="84C" Pressure="175bar" />
    <Wax CloudPointTemp="32C" MolecularDiffusionCoeff="1.5e-9" WaxDensity="885" />
    <HeatTransfer Type="WATER" AmbientTemperature="3.5C" AmbientHeatTransferCoeff="260">
      <Layer Material="DUPLEX_STEEL" Thickness="0.018" Conductivity="19.0" />
      <Layer Material="AEROGEL_BLANKET" Thickness="0.035" Conductivity="0.024" />
      <Layer Material="CARRIER_STEEL" Thickness="0.014" Conductivity="45.0" />
    </HeatTransfer>
  </Flowpath>

  <Node Name="WELLHEAD_XMT" Type="TERMINAL" Flowpath="INSULATED_PIP_TIEBACK" BoundaryPosition="0.0" MassRate="26.0" Temperature="84C" Pressure="175bar" />
  <Node Name="HOST_PLATFORM_SEP" Type="PRESSURE" Flowpath="INSULATED_PIP_TIEBACK" BoundaryPosition="1.0" Pressure="30bar" Temperature="22C" />
</Model>

title: Subsea Tieback with PVT Table & Restart Ramp
description: Full deepwater subsea tieback coupled to an external tabular PVT fluid property file with Vogel wellbore IPR, insulated riser, and active anti-slug choke control for restart ramp-up.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Model Title="Deepwater Subsea Tieback with PVT Table and Restart Ramp" Author="FlowAssuranceTeam" TableFile="fluid_pvt.tab">
  <Integration StartTime="0" EndTime="14400" MinDt="0.002" MaxDt="0.35" />

  <Flowpath Name="NORTH_FIELD_TIEBACK">
    <Pipe Label="FLOWLINE_EAST" Length="4200" Diameter="0.273" Elevation="-310" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="14" />
    <Pipe Label="FLOWLINE_WEST" Length="3000" Diameter="0.273" Elevation="-60" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="10" />
    <Pipe Label="STEEL_CATENARY_RISER" Length="1600" Diameter="0.254" Elevation="380" Roughness="4.5e-5" Discretization="8" />
    <Valve Name="RESTART_CHOKE" AbsolutePosition="8750" Diameter="0.16" Opening="0.72" Cd="0.83" />
    <Controller Name="RESTART_PID" Type="PID" SetPoint="58.0" Gain="0.90" Ti="40.0" Td="1.5" Transmitter="PT_RISER_TOP" ControlledValve="RESTART_CHOKE" />
    <Ipr Type="VOGEL" ReservoirPressure="230bar" ReservoirTemperature="88C" BubblePointPressure="145bar" MaxLiquidRate="55.0" GasMassFraction="0.22" WaterCut="0.08" />
    <HeatTransfer Type="WATER" AmbientTemperature="4C" AmbientHeatTransferCoeff="240">
      <Layer Material="CARBON_STEEL" Thickness="0.022" Conductivity="45.0" />
      <Layer Material="POLYURETHANE" Thickness="0.050" Conductivity="0.15" />
    </HeatTransfer>
  </Flowpath>

  <Node Name="MANIFOLD_NORTH" Type="TERMINAL" Flowpath="NORTH_FIELD_TIEBACK" BoundaryPosition="0.0" MassRate="42.0" Temperature="82C" Pressure="185bar" />
  <Node Name="TOPSIDE_FIRST_STAGE" Type="PRESSURE" Flowpath="NORTH_FIELD_TIEBACK" BoundaryPosition="1.0" Pressure="35bar" Temperature="26C" />
</Model>
